shop.Cows.name: Cow barn
shop.Cows.about: Repairs the cow barn. 2 cows already live inside, and you get the milk() command.
shop.Hen.name: Hen
shop.Hen.about: One more hen in the henhouse, if there's room.
shop.Cow.name: Cow
shop.Cow.about: One more cow in the cow barn, if there's room.
shop.HensBig.name: Big henhouse
shop.HensBig.about: The henhouse grows one size bigger (5×5, 6×6, 7×7). That means room for more hens.
shop.CowsBig.name: Big cow barn
shop.CowsBig.about: The cow barn grows one size bigger (6×6, 7×7).
shop.FeedTrough.name: Feed trough
shop.FeedTrough.about: One more feed trough. Put it on any empty tile: build(Machines.FeedTrough).
shop.WaterTrough.name: Water trough
shop.WaterTrough.about: One more water trough. Put it down with build(Machines.WaterTrough).
shop.Speed.name: Fast drones
shop.Speed.about: All the ranch drones get 1.5 times faster.
shop.Hands.name: Big hands
shop.Hands.about: The drone can carry more: 5, then 10, then 20.
shop.buy.about: The market drone buys feed: grain or hay bales.
shop.pet.about: Pets the animals standing under the drone. They get happier.
shop.clean.about: Cleans the tile and tells you how dirty it is.
shop.animals.about: A list of all the animals in the area. Each animal is an object.
shop.cart.about: The cart brings hay bales from the farm (10,000 wheat → 1 bale).
shop.orders.about: Orders from the villagers. They pay more than the market does.
shop.Workshop.name: Workshop
shop.Workshop.about: Repairs the workshop and its dairy. You get the make() command: matsun (Armenian yogurt), cheese and butter.
shop.Stove.name: Stove
shop.Stove.about: Omelets in the workshop (2 eggs and butter). Put it down with build(Machines.Stove).
shop.Goats.name: Goat pen
shop.Goats.about: Repairs the goat pen, with 2 goats inside. Goats push on the fence, so you get the repair() and rope() commands.
shop.Goat.name: Goat
shop.Goat.about: One more goat in the goat pen, if there's room.
shop.GoatsBig.name: Big goat pen
shop.GoatsBig.about: The goat pen grows one size bigger (6×6, 7×7).
shop.Drones.name: Extra drone
shop.Drones.about: One more drone in every area, with newDrone(), just like on the farm.
shop.events.about: when(): the drone listens for events (an egg, a ready cow, hunger…) and answers them when it's free.
shop.board.about: The ranch's shared board. Drones write on it with write() and read it with read().
shop.sellAnimals.about: The market drone sells an animal to the villagers by its id. A rare color sells for more.
shop.heal.about: heal(): cures a sick animal standing under the drone, if the drone is holding medicine.
shop.ship.about: ship(): the cart takes ranch goods to the farm. Manure turns into humus.
shop.FarmSpeed.name: Fast farm
shop.FarmSpeed.about: The farm drones are 1.5 times faster for 10 minutes. You can buy it again.
shop.Sheep.name: Sheepfold
shop.Sheep.about: Repairs the sheepfold, with 3 sheep, a spinning wheel and a loom. You get the shear(), carpet(), weave(), carpetOrders() and sellCarpet() commands.
shop.OneSheep.name: Sheep
shop.OneSheep.about: One more sheep in the sheepfold, if there's room.
shop.SheepBig.name: Big sheepfold
shop.SheepBig.about: The sheepfold grows one size bigger (7×7, 8×8). The shearing corner is always the top right corner.
shop.Bell.about: ringBell(): the sheep come to the tile where the bell rang and stay there for a few seconds.
shop.Gampr.about: A gampr, the Armenian shepherd dog, moves into the sheepfold. gamprGo() walks him around, and the sheep stay away from him, just like from the drone.
shop.DyePot.name: Dye pot
shop.DyePot.about: Dyes white yarn with plants. Put it in the sheepfold: build(Machines.DyePot).
shop.Bees.name: Apiary
shop.Bees.about: Repairs the apiary, with a hive and a honey house. You get the sow() and flowerKinds() commands.
shop.Hive.name: Hive
shop.Hive.about: One more hive in the apiary. Put it down with build(Machines.Hive).
shop.BeesBig.name: Big apiary
shop.BeesBig.about: The apiary grows one size bigger (6×6, 7×7).
shop.Buffalo.name: Buffalo pen
shop.Buffalo.about: Repairs the buffalo pen, with 2 buffaloes and a mud pool. Buffaloes give lots of milk and love water.
shop.OneBuffalo.name: Buffalo
shop.OneBuffalo.about: One more buffalo in the buffalo pen, if there's room.
shop.BuffaloBig.name: Big buffalo pen
shop.BuffaloBig.about: The buffalo pen grows one size bigger (6×6, 7×7).
shop.Rabbits.name: Rabbit hutch
shop.Rabbits.about: Repairs the rabbit hutch, with 2 rabbits. They eat eggplants, give fluff and multiply really fast.
shop.OneRabbit.name: Rabbit
shop.OneRabbit.about: One more rabbit in the rabbit hutch, if there's room.
shop.RabbitsBig.name: Big rabbit hutch
shop.RabbitsBig.about: The rabbit hutch grows one size bigger (5×5, 6×6).
shop.Donkey.name: Donkey
shop.Donkey.about: The donkey carries big loads to the farm and back. donkeyBring() and donkeyShip() work from any area.
shop.dishes.about: eat(): an omelet or a honey cake makes all the ranch drones faster for a while.
shop.Fair.name: Fair invitation
shop.Fair.about: Once every area is repaired, the village invites you to the fair. You get the fair() command.
story.intro.0.text: Welcome to the ranch! This old ranch behind the village has stood empty for years. The fences are broken and the barns have fallen down.
story.intro.1.text: A kind villager gave us two hens and 50 ֏ (dram, Armenian money). That's our start. Little by little, we'll bring the whole ranch back to life.
story.intro.2.text: Everything here is alive. Hens walk around, get hungry and thirsty, and lay eggs only when they're happy.
story.intro.3.text: Every area has its own drone and its own code. In the code window you'll find the tabs "havanoc" (the henhouse) and "shuka" (the market). The big ▶ button runs them all together, and the small ▶ on a tab runs only that area.
story.intro.4.text: The drone can hold only a few things at a time. It picks up an egg with gather(), and on the basket tile it puts things into storage with unload().
story.intro.5.text: You take feed from the basket and water from the well with take(), and pour them into the troughs with fill(). The market drone sells the eggs, and with ֏ you can buy new animals and commands in the "Shop".
story.areas.Cows.0.text: The cow barn is fixed, and two cows are already inside.
story.areas.Cows.1.text: Cows walk around, so the drone has to find them. When a cow is ready, milk() on her tile gives milk. Cows eat hay bales: Goods.HayBale.
story.areas.Cows.2.text: Two happy cows and some free space: soon you'll have a calf! A baby gets its parent's color, and sometimes one is born in a rare color.
story.areas.Workshop.0.text: The workshop is working again. Here milk turns into matsun, cheese and butter.
story.areas.Workshop.1.text: The workshop drone takes milk from the basket with take(Goods.Milk, 3), brings it to the dairy and pours it in with fill(). Then make(Goods.Cheese) starts the cheese.
story.areas.Workshop.2.text: The machine works for a few seconds. When it's ready, gather() picks up the cheese, and unload() puts it into storage. Cheese is worth much more than milk.
story.areas.Goats.0.text: There are two goats in the goat pen. They give milk, but they're super stubborn: they butt the fence with their heads.
story.areas.Goats.1.text: When a piece of the fence breaks, a hole opens and a goat runs off to the village. repair() fixes the hole with a plank, and rope() brings the runaway back on a rope.
story.areas.Sheep.0.text: The sheepfold is alive again! Three sheep live inside, with a spinning wheel and an old loom next to them. This is where Armenian carpets are born.
story.areas.Sheep.1.text: Sheep are shy. When the drone comes within 2 tiles, they move away. The rest of the time, they stay close together.
story.areas.Sheep.2.text: You can shear only in the top right corner, on the marked 2×2 tiles. Walk up to a sheep so you're not between her and the corner, and she'll go there by herself. In the corner, she has nowhere else to go.
story.areas.Bees.0.text: The bees are back! The apiary already has a hive and a honey house.
story.areas.Bees.1.text: The more different flowers grow near the hive (up to 2 tiles away), the faster it fills. Five of the same flower count as one kind, but five different ones make honey five times faster.
story.areas.Bees.2.text: Careful: next to the hive the bees sting, and the drone works twice as slowly. When you make your first honey, you'll get the Beekeeper hat, and the bees won't sting anymore.
story.areas.Buffalo.0.text: Buffaloes are big and strong, and they give lots of milk. Their milk makes the most expensive cheese of all: Lori cheese, named after the Lori region of Armenia.
story.areas.Buffalo.1.text: But a buffalo gets hot quickly. A hot buffalo gives no milk until it has a bath in the mud pool. In summer it gets hot even faster. The mud pool must always have water: bring it from the well and pour it in with fill().
story.areas.Rabbits.0.text: The rabbits are home. They eat eggplants, and their fluff makes soft yarn. A carpet with soft yarn sells for more.
story.areas.Rabbits.1.text: Rabbits multiply really fast, and the more there are, the faster it goes. When the hutch is full, they're too crowded to give fluff. Count them with animals() and sell the extra ones to the villagers with sellAnimal().
story.firstCarpet.0.text: Your first carpet is ready, and the village gives you a papakh, a tall wool hat! The market drone sells carpets with sellCarpet().
story.firstCarpet.1.text: One loop is enough for one row. But a carpet has 9 rows. Put that loop inside another loop for y, and two lines of code will weave all 81 knots.
story.firstCarpet.2.text: The color can depend on x and y. For example, y % 2 is different for every other row, and that's how you get stripes. With (x + y) % 2, you get checkers.
story.firstCarpet.3.text: Armenian patterns are symmetrical. Math.abs(x - 4) tells you how far x is from the middle, and the same goes for y. When you pick the color by these distances, the pattern comes out symmetrical all by itself: rings, crosses, diamonds.
story.fairOpen.0.text: Every area is repaired! The villagers can't believe their eyes. They're inviting the ranch to the big fair of the year.
story.fairOpen.1.text: Buy the fair invitation in the "Shop". The "Market" window shows what to bring: goods and one really good carpet.
story.fair.0.text: The whole village has gathered in the square. The cheeses, the honey, the candles and, most of all, your carpet amazed everyone.
story.fair.1.text: The ranch won the fair prize! You get the Rancher hat. Now you're a real ranch owner.
story.fair.2.text: The old ranch that was half in ruins is now the pride of the village. And your code did all of it. Thank you, friend.
story.fair.3.text: If you want a harder game, you can start the ranch over from the "Market" window. Your code stays, and the animals get hungry faster, but goods sell for more.
lessons.buy.0.text: buy(item, amount): the market drone buys feed and puts it into storage. The price changes every day, so check it with price().
lessons.pet.0.text: pet(): pets the animals standing under the drone. A petted animal is happier for a minute and gives more.
lessons.clean.0.text: Animals make the tiles they stand on dirty. dirt() shows how dirty the tile under the drone is (from 0 to 100), and wipe() cleans it.
lessons.animals.0.text: animals() is the list of the animals in your area. Each animal is an object: tesak (kind), x, y, sov (hunger), carav (thirst), tramadrutyun (mood) and patrast (the cow is ready to milk).
lessons.animals.1.text: With the list, you can find the hungriest animal, or the cow that's ready to milk. Think about which list functions can help.
lessons.cart.0.text: bring(Goods.HayBale, amount): the cart brings hay bales from the farm. Each bale takes 10,000 wheat from the farm's storage. Only the market drone can call the cart.
lessons.Workshop.0.text: make(item): the machine starts making something, if there's enough inside. The dairy makes Goods.Matsun, Goods.Cheese and Goods.Butter.
lessons.Stove.0.text: The stove makes omelets: 2 eggs and 1 butter. First put it on an empty tile in the workshop: build(Machines.Stove).
lessons.events.0.text: when("name", function): the drone starts listening for an event. When the event happens, the function gets called. That's how the buttons on every website work, too.
lessons.events.1.text: Here's a big secret: JavaScript does one thing at a time. The function is called only when the drone is free, meaning its code has finished. Until then, the events wait in line.
lessons.events.2.text: If your code is while (true), it never finishes, so the when() functions will never be called. The events are: "dzu" (egg), "kat" (milk), "sovac" (hungry), "datark" (empty), "patrast" (ready), "ancq" (hole), "grum" (written on the board), "esh" (donkey) and "gorg" (carpet).
lessons.board.0.text: The ranch board belongs to all the drones. write("name", value) writes, and read("name") reads. That way the henhouse drone can tell the market drone it needs grain.
lessons.board.1.text: Whenever someone writes on the board, every drone gets the grum event. e.anun tells you which name changed.
lessons.sellAnimals.0.text: sellAnimal(id): the market drone sells an animal to a villager. Babies can't be sold, and a rare color is worth three times as much. Sometimes orders ask for an animal of a certain color, too.
lessons.heal.0.text: An animal that stands on a dirty tile for a long time gets sick: it gives nothing and feels sad. The market drone buys medicine: buy(Goods.Medicine, 2).
lessons.heal.1.text: Then the area's drone takes the medicine from the basket, goes to the sick animal and calls heal(). In animals(), hivand (sick) tells you who is sick.
lessons.ship.0.text: ship(item, amount): the cart takes ranch goods to the farm. Manure (you get it when you clean) turns into humus for the farm, and eggs and butter are needed for the village's nazook.
lessons.Drones.0.text: Now every area can have one more drone. newDrone(function) works just like on the farm, and the drones can talk through the board.
lessons.Sheep.0.text: shear(): shears the sheep under the drone, if her wool is ready and she's in the corner. In animals(), patrast tells you whose wool is ready. A white sheep gives white wool, a black one gives black wool.
lessons.Sheep.1.text: The spinning wheel turns wool into yarn. Put the wool into the wheel with fill(), then call make(Goods.WhiteYarn). One wool makes 5 yarn. When it's ready, gather() picks it up.
lessons.Sheep.2.text: A carpet has 9 rows of 9 knots. Put yarn into the loom with fill(). Then, on the loom's tile, carpet(0) starts the first order, and carpet() starts your very own carpet.
lessons.Sheep.3.text: weave(x, y, color) weaves one knot per second. A knot can't be changed, so think before you weave. The carpet is done with the 81st knot. A whole row takes just one loop:
lessons.Sheep.4.text: The "Loom" button opens a big window. There you'll see your carpet next to the pattern, and how well they match. An order pays its price times the match percentage.
lessons.Bell.0.text: ringBell(): the bell rings on the drone's tile. The sheep come there and aren't scared for a few seconds. Go to the corner, ring, wait, and then you can shear.
lessons.Gampr.0.text: The gampr is a real Armenian shepherd dog. gamprGo(direction) walks him, and the sheep stay away from him, just like from the drone. Together, you two can drive the flock from both sides.
lessons.DyePot.0.text: The dye pot turns 5 white yarn and one plant into 5 colored yarn: watermelon makes red, eggplant orange, sunflower yellow, a hay bale green, and grapes blue.
lessons.DyePot.1.text: The market drone brings plants from the farm: bring(Goods.Watermelon, 1). First put the dye pot on an empty tile in the sheepfold with build(Machines.DyePot), fill it with the yarn and the plant, then call make(Goods.RedYarn).
lessons.Bees.0.text: sow(Flowers.Rose) plants a flower under the drone. The market drone buys seeds with buy(Goods.Seed, 5), and the apiary drone takes them from the basket. The flowers are Poppy, Daisy, Rose, Jasmine and Sunflower.
lessons.Bees.1.text: flowerKinds() tells you how many different flowers are around the drone. On the hive's tile, 5 is as good as it gets. wipe() removes a flower if you want to plant it somewhere else.
lessons.Bees.2.text: From a full hive, gather() takes a honeycomb. In the honey house, a honeycomb becomes honey (make(Goods.Honey)) or beeswax (make(Goods.Wax)), and 2 beeswax make a candle. when("patrast", …) tells you when the hive is full.
lessons.Hive.0.text: One more hive! Put it on an empty tile in the apiary: build(Machines.Hive). Think: where will the same flowers help both hives?
lessons.Buffalo.0.text: In animals(), shog shows how hot the buffalo is. When it gets very hot, it walks to the mud pool by itself, if there's water there. You milk a buffalo with milk(), and in the dairy its milk becomes Goods.LoriCheese.
lessons.Rabbits.0.text: shear() takes fluff from a rabbit, and here you don't need a corner. In the spinning wheel, 2 fluff become 5 soft yarn: make(Goods.SoftYarn). In a carpet, weave(x, y, Colors.Soft) counts as white, but it makes the carpet worth more.
lessons.Rabbits.1.text: The market drone brings eggplants: bring(Goods.Eggplant, 1). One crate costs 2,000 eggplants from the farm.
lessons.Donkey.0.text: The donkey carries big loads: donkeyBring(item, amount) brings them from the farm, and donkeyShip(item, amount) takes them to the farm. These commands work from any area.
lessons.Donkey.1.text: The donkey makes one trip at a time, and each trip takes a few seconds. While he's walking, the drone can do other work. When he arrives, when("esh", function) will hear about it: e.ir (the item) and e.qanak (the amount) tell you what he brought.
lessons.dishes.0.text: eat(Goods.HoneyCake): all the ranch drones work faster for a while. The food comes from storage. Honey cake is baked in the stove from honey, eggs, butter and flour.
lessons.Fair.0.text: fair(): the market drone delivers all the goods for the fair, plus one carpet. Look in the "Market" window to see what's needed. The carpet must not be sold.
lessons.orders.0.text: orders() is the list of today's orders. Each order is an object: anun is the name, irer the goods, gin the price, and katarvac tells you if it's done. deliver(number) delivers an order if all the goods are in storage.
quests.ranch_egg.title: The first egg
quests.ranch_egg.text: Pick up the egg and put it into storage on the basket tile.
quests.ranch_egg.hints.0: The egg is lying on one of the henhouse tiles. Look at the map, or check with whatsHere().
quests.ranch_egg.hints.1: On the egg's tile, gather() puts the egg into the drone's hands.
quests.ranch_egg.hints.2: Then the drone goes back to tile (0, 0), where the basket is, and calls unload().
quests.ranch_egg.done: The first egg is in storage
quests.ranch_troughs.title: Feed and water
quests.ranch_troughs.text: Fill the feed trough and the water trough: take() and fill().
quests.ranch_troughs.hints.0: On the basket tile, take(Goods.Grain, 3) takes grain from storage.
quests.ranch_troughs.hints.1: On the well tile, take(Goods.Water, 3) takes water.
quests.ranch_troughs.hints.2: On a feed trough or water trough tile, fill() pours in whatever the drone is holding. Look at the map to see where the troughs are.
quests.ranch_troughs.done: The hens are full and happy
quests.ranch_sell.title: The first sale
quests.ranch_sell.text: In the market code, sell the eggs and earn 10 ֏.
quests.ranch_sell.hints.0: Pick the "shuka" tab. That's where the market drone works.
quests.ranch_sell.hints.1: sell(Goods.Egg, 5) sells 5 eggs at today's price. Without an amount, it sells them all.
quests.ranch_sell.hints.2: Write the sell command in the market tab and press that tab's ▶.
quests.ranch_grain.title: Buy grain
quests.ranch_grain.text: Get the buy() command in the shop, then buy 5 grain.
quests.ranch_grain.hints.0: The Shop button is at the top. buy() costs 15 ֏.
quests.ranch_grain.hints.1: In the market tab, buy(Goods.Grain, 5) buys 5 grain.
quests.ranch_grain.done: Now the hens will always have food
quests.ranch_loop.title: Automatic henhouse
quests.ranch_loop.text: Write a loop so the drone always gathers eggs and feeds the hens. Collect 20 eggs.
quests.ranch_loop.hints.0: A while (true) { … } loop repeats the code without ever stopping.
quests.ranch_loop.hints.1: On each round, the drone can walk over all the tiles and pick up the eggs, then empty its hands at the basket.
quests.ranch_loop.hints.2: Every now and then, check the feed trough and the water trough and fill them. The drone's hands can get full, so go to the basket every few eggs.
quests.ranch_loop.done: The henhouse runs all by itself
quests.ranch_animals.title: Animal list
quests.ranch_animals.text: Get animals() in the shop and use it in your code.
quests.ranch_animals.hints.0: animals() gives you a list: its length is .length, and the first animal is [0].
quests.ranch_animals.hints.1: Every animal has an x and a y, so the drone can go straight to it.
quests.ranch_animals.done: Now you know where every animal is
quests.ranch_cows.title: The cow barn
quests.ranch_cows.text: Repair the cow barn: buy it in the "Shop".
quests.ranch_cows.hints.0: The cow barn costs 300 ֏. Sell eggs until you have enough ֏.
quests.ranch_milk.title: The first milk
quests.ranch_milk.text: Milk a cow and put the milk into storage.
quests.ranch_milk.hints.0: A cow has to be fed and happy to give milk.
quests.ranch_milk.hints.1: milk() works only on the tile where a ready cow is standing. Cows walk around, so check where they are.
quests.ranch_milk.hints.2: After milking, the milk is in the drone's hands. Unload it at the basket.
quests.ranch_cart.title: A cart from the farm
quests.ranch_cart.text: Get bring() in the shop and bring 2 hay bales from the farm.
quests.ranch_cart.hints.0: Only the market drone can call the cart.
quests.ranch_cart.hints.1: bring(Goods.HayBale, 2) takes 20,000 wheat from the farm's storage.
quests.ranch_cart.done: The farm and the ranch are friends now
quests.ranch_order.title: A villager's order
quests.ranch_order.text: Get orders() in the shop and complete one order.
quests.ranch_order.hints.0: The Market button shows today's orders.
quests.ranch_order.hints.1: deliver(0) delivers the first order, if everything is in storage.
quests.ranch_clean.title: A clean ranch
quests.ranch_clean.text: Get wipe() in the shop and clean the dirty tiles.
quests.ranch_clean.hints.0: dirt() tells you how dirty the tile under the drone is.
quests.ranch_clean.hints.1: Go over all the tiles and clean the ones that are very dirty.
quests.ranch_workshop.title: Workshop
quests.ranch_workshop.text: Repair the workshop and make your first cheese.
quests.ranch_workshop.hints.0: The workshop costs 500 ֏, and you need the cow barn first.
quests.ranch_workshop.hints.1: Take 3 milk from the workshop's basket with take(Goods.Milk, 3), go to the dairy and call fill().
quests.ranch_workshop.hints.2: After make(Goods.Cheese), wait until the cheese is ready, then gather() it and unload() at the basket.
quests.ranch_events.title: The listening drone
quests.ranch_events.text: Get when() and write code that answers an event.
quests.ranch_events.hints.0: when("dzu", function) calls the function for every new egg.
quests.ranch_events.hints.1: The function gets an object with e.x and e.y, so the drone can go there and gather().
quests.ranch_events.hints.2: Don't write while (true) in the same code: events are called only after the code has finished.
quests.ranch_events.done: The drone is listening to the ranch
quests.ranch_board.title: Drone chat
quests.ranch_board.text: Get the board and write on it with write().
quests.ranch_board.hints.0: In one tab write("grain", 5), in another read("grain").
quests.ranch_board.hints.1: The market drone can read how much grain is needed and buy exactly that much.
quests.ranch_board.done: The drones talk to each other now
quests.ranch_goats.title: Stubborn goats
quests.ranch_goats.text: Repair the goat pen and fix the hole in the fence.
quests.ranch_goats.hints.1: The market drone gets planks: bring(Goods.Plank, 1) (10,000 wood) or buy(Goods.Plank, 1).
quests.ranch_goats.hints.2: The goat pen drone takes the plank from the basket, goes to the tile next to the hole and calls repair(). when("ancq", …) tells you where the hole is.
quests.ranch_rope.title: The runaway is home
quests.ranch_rope.text: Bring the runaway goat back on a rope: rope().
quests.ranch_rope.hints.0: Fix all the holes first, or the goat will run off again.
quests.ranch_rope.hints.1: rope() works on any tile next to the fence and takes a few seconds.
quests.ranch_heal.title: Vet
quests.ranch_heal.text: Get heal() and cure a sick animal.
quests.ranch_heal.hints.0: The market drone buys medicine: buy(Goods.Medicine, 1).
quests.ranch_heal.hints.1: In animals(), find the animal whose hivand is true, go to it holding the medicine and call heal().
quests.ranch_heal.hints.2: Even better: keep the tiles clean, so nobody gets sick.
quests.ranch_ship.title: A cart to the farm
quests.ranch_ship.text: Get ship() and send ranch goods to the farm.
quests.ranch_ship.hints.0: Only the market drone can send the cart.
quests.ranch_ship.hints.1: ship(Goods.Manure, 5) turns 5 manure into 15 humus on the farm.
quests.ranch_ship.done: The farm says thank you to the ranch
quests.ranch_2000.title: Ranch master
quests.ranch_2000.hints.0: Cheese and butter are worth much more than milk. And orders pay more.
quests.ranch_500.title: A real ranch
quests.ranch_500.hints.0: More hens, more eggs. Cow milk is worth a lot, and orders pay more.
quests.ranch_500.done: The ranch has come to life
quests.ranch_sheep.title: The sheepfold
quests.ranch_sheep.text: Repair the sheepfold and shear a sheep.
quests.ranch_sheep.hints.0: The sheepfold costs 1,500 ֏, and you need the goat pen and the workshop first.
quests.ranch_sheep.hints.1: animals() shows where the sheep is. Come at her from the side opposite the corner, and she'll walk toward the corner.
quests.ranch_sheep.hints.2: When the sheep is in the top right corner, go to her tile and call shear(). Her wool must be ready: patrast.
quests.ranch_yarn.title: Yarn from the wheel
quests.ranch_yarn.text: Use the spinning wheel to turn wool into yarn.
quests.ranch_yarn.hints.0: The drone must be holding wool and standing on the spinning wheel's tile. fill() puts the wool into the wheel.
quests.ranch_yarn.hints.1: Tell make() which yarn you want: from white wool, Goods.WhiteYarn.
quests.ranch_yarn.hints.2: A few seconds later, gather() picks up the yarn. If the drone's hands are small, the rest stays in the wheel.
quests.ranch_carpet.title: The first carpet
quests.ranch_carpet.text: Weave your first carpet. It can be any color you like.
quests.ranch_carpet.hints.0: A carpet needs 81 yarn. Bring yarn to the loom's tile as many times as you need, and call fill() each time.
quests.ranch_carpet.hints.1: On the loom's tile, first call carpet() or carpet(0), then weave(x, y, color) for each knot.
quests.ranch_carpet.hints.2: Put the loop for one row inside another loop: the outer one changes y from 0 to 8, the inner one changes x.
quests.ranch_carpet.hints.3: Watch your carpet grow in the "Loom" window.
quests.ranch_carpet.done: The whole village is talking about your carpet
quests.ranch_perfect.title: A perfect carpet
quests.ranch_perfect.text: Weave an order carpet that matches its pattern 100%.
quests.ranch_perfect.hints.0: In the "Loom" window, open the "Orders" tab and pick the easiest pattern.
quests.ranch_perfect.hints.1: Look at the pattern and think: what changes from row to row, or from column to column? Pick the color with if, based on x and y.
quests.ranch_perfect.hints.2: For a frame: on the edge tiles, x or y is 0 or 8. For a cross: x or y is 4.
quests.ranch_perfect.hints.3: Math.abs(x - 4) and Math.abs(y - 4) help when the pattern is symmetrical around the middle.
quests.ranch_dye.title: Colors
quests.ranch_dye.text: Get the dye pot and dye some yarn.
quests.ranch_dye.hints.0: Put the dye pot in the sheepfold: build(Machines.DyePot).
quests.ranch_dye.hints.1: The market drone brings the plant with bring(Goods.Watermelon, 1), and the sheepfold drone takes it from the basket.
quests.ranch_dye.hints.2: Put 5 white yarn and the plant into the dye pot, then call make(Goods.RedYarn).
quests.ranch_bees.title: Flowers for the bees
quests.ranch_bees.text: Repair the apiary, plant flowers and find out how many kinds grow near the hive.
quests.ranch_bees.hints.0: The market drone buys seeds with buy(Goods.Seed, 5). The apiary drone takes them from the basket with take(Goods.Seed, 3).
quests.ranch_bees.hints.1: Go near the hive and plant different flowers: sow(Flowers.Rose), sow(Flowers.Poppy)…
quests.ranch_bees.hints.2: On the hive's tile, call say(flowerKinds()). The bigger the number, the faster the hive fills.
quests.ranch_honey.title: Honey
quests.ranch_honey.text: Make honey and put it into storage.
quests.ranch_honey.hints.0: When the hive is full, gather() on its tile takes a honeycomb.
quests.ranch_honey.hints.1: On the honey house tile, call fill() and make(Goods.Honey).
quests.ranch_honey.hints.2: When it's ready, gather() it and unload() on the basket tile.
quests.ranch_buffalo.title: Buffaloes
quests.ranch_buffalo.text: Repair the buffalo pen and collect buffalo milk.
quests.ranch_buffalo.hints.0: A buffalo needs feed, water and a mud pool. Take water from the well and pour it in on the mud pool tile: fill().
quests.ranch_buffalo.hints.1: In animals(), shog shows how hot a buffalo is. When there's water in the pool, the buffalo goes for a bath by itself.
quests.ranch_buffalo.hints.2: On a ready buffalo's tile, call milk(), then unload() at the basket.
quests.ranch_rabbits.title: A rabbit family
quests.ranch_rabbits.text: Repair the rabbit hutch, collect 5 fluff and sell an extra rabbit.
quests.ranch_rabbits.hints.0: Rabbits eat eggplants. The market drone brings them: bring(Goods.Eggplant, 1).
quests.ranch_rabbits.hints.1: shear() works on any tile of the hutch, if the rabbit is ready.
quests.ranch_rabbits.hints.2: When there are too many rabbits, they crowd each other and give no fluff. Check animals().length, and sell the extra one in the market code: sellAnimal(id).
quests.ranch_donkey.title: The donkey hits the road
quests.ranch_donkey.text: Buy the donkey and send him to the farm for a load.
quests.ranch_donkey.hints.0: donkeyBring(Goods.Eggplant, 5) works from the code of any area.
quests.ranch_donkey.hints.1: If the farm doesn't have enough eggplants, the donkey brings fewer or doesn't go at all. Read the warning.
quests.ranch_cake.title: Honey cake
quests.ranch_cake.text: Make a honey cake, the most valuable food of all.
quests.ranch_cake.hints.0: The stove needs 1 honey, 2 eggs, 1 butter and 1 flour.
quests.ranch_cake.hints.1: The market drone brings flour: bring(Goods.Flour, 1).
quests.ranch_fair.title: The village fair
quests.ranch_fair.text: Repair every area, buy the invitation and deliver everything to the fair.
quests.ranch_fair.hints.0: The bottom of the "Market" window shows what the fair needs.
quests.ranch_fair.hints.1: Don't sell your best carpet. The fair needs a carpet that matches its pattern very closely.
quests.ranch_fair.hints.2: When everything is in storage, call fair() in the market code.
